content.title: City of Arvada Private Activity Bonds
content.summary: Private Activity Bonds (PABs) in Arvada provide low-cost financing to stimulate private investment in projects such as affordable housing and infrastructure. For 2026, the City has a PAB allocation of $8,306,668, adding to a total of $16,253,486 available for funding this year. The City is currently accepting applications for these bonds, particularly for affordable housing development or preservation, and projects do not necessarily need to be located in Arvada but should align with the city's goals.
content.body:
Private Activity Bonds (PABs) offer low-cost financing to encourage private sector investment in communities throughout the country. PABs support investment in projects that increase the tax base of a local community, including:

1. Affordable Housing
2. Economic development/manufacturing
3. Infrastructure
4. Environmental projects

The City of Arvada annually receives a PAB allocation from the Colorado Department of Local Affairs that allows tax-exempt bond financing for various economic development and/or affordable housing projects. The City's 2025 PAB allocation was $7,946,818. This amount was rolled over to this year’s funding cycle. The 2026 PAB allocation is $8,306,668, for a total of **$16,253,486** available to be assigned for this year’s funding cycle.

The City of Arvada is accepting applications for the City's Private Activity Bond allocation. Applications will be accepted to develop or preserve affordable housing.

More information about the City of Arvada’s 2026 PAB allocation and application process can be found below:

The following are the City of Arvada's PAB Application and Policies:

- [City of Arvada Private Activity Bond Notice of Available Funding (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/5106)
- [City of Arvada Private Activity Bond Application](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/66084)
- [City of Arvada Private Activity Bond Underwriter Application](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/66086)
- [City of Arvada Private Activity Bond Policy (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/399)

## Responses to questions submitted with 2026 application

**Question:** I assume that PABs are only available from the City if the project is located in Arvada. Is there more flexibility when it comes to PABs in the City’s policies?

**Answer:**Our bond policy does not currently mandate that the project be in Arvada (or Arvada adjacent); however, two of our evaluation criteria are "How well the project applied for meets the land use, economic development and/or affordable housing goals of the City of Arvada" and  "Proposed projects should align with the City of Arvada Comprehensive Plan priorities." This may put non-Arvada projects at a disadvantage. 

Please email [Samantha Bradley](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8af9e8f8ebeee6eff3caebf8fcebeeeba4e5f8ed) or call her at 720-898-7479 with any questions.
